summary: Updates IANA registries so the SEED block cipher can be used for SRTP and SRTCP in Multimedia Internet KEYing (MIKEY). It adds registry values only and is informational.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 5748 adds MIKEY registry values for using the SEED cipher with SRTP and SRTCP. It records three encryption modes and one pseudorandom function value.

subtitle: Adds SEED algorithm code points to MIKEY registries for SRTP and SRTCP.

tldr.problem: MIKEY registries lacked code points to indicate SEED cipher use for SRTP and SRTCP.
tldr.mechanism: IANA added three SEED modes to the SRTP encryption algorithm registry and added SEED-CTR to the SRTP pseudorandom function registry.
tldr.outcome: RFC 5748 is Informational and records the registry updates for using SEED in MIKEY payloads.

today: RFC 5748 is Informational. The unit metadata lists no RFC that obsoletes or updates it.

sections.title: SEED in MIKEY
sections.content: RFC 5748 updates IANA registries to support SEED in the Secure Real-time Transport Protocol (SRTP) and Secure Real-time Transport Control Protocol (SRTCP) when used with Multimedia Internet KEYing (MIKEY). The RFC describes SEED as a 128-bit symmetric-key block cipher with a 128-bit block size and a 16-round Feistel structure.
sections.plainLanguage: This RFC lets MIKEY identify SEED for SRTP and SRTCP. It records the cipher's block size, key length, and structure as described in the memo.

sections.title: New MIKEY Code Points
sections.content: IANA added SEED-CTR, SEED-CCM, and SEED-GCM as SRTP encryption algorithm values 3, 4, and 5. In the SRTP pseudorandom function subregistry, SEED-CTR was added as value 1. The RFC identifies the modes as defined in RFC 5669.
sections.plainLanguage: Three SEED modes receive values in the encryption algorithm list. SEED-CTR also receives a value in the pseudorandom function list.

sections.title: Security Considerations
sections.content: The RFC states that no security problem had been found on SEED and describes the attacks it considered known at the time. It points readers to a self-evaluation report for further security considerations. IANA amended the MIKEY payload subregistries as specified in the document.
sections.plainLanguage: The RFC reports no known security problem with SEED and points to an evaluation report. It also records the registry changes that this document specifies.
